latest_release.name: MyGo 0.9.0
latest_release.body:
## Breaking changes

- `sqlite.LibraryPath` and the `MYGO_SQLITE_LIBRARY` environment variable have been removed. SQLite now loads through the native module system. To point it at a different library, set `MYGO_NATIVE_SQLITECORE`.

## Highlights

- **Native modules (experimental).** Implement a Go interface in Swift, Rust, or Zig, and call it from your app. `mygo dev` generates and builds it. The API may change in breaking ways before it is stable.
- **Native video.** `ui/video` plays video with each system's own engine: AVFoundation on macOS, Media Foundation on Windows, GStreamer on Linux, and the video element in browsers. Play, pause, seek, rate, volume, mute, and loop.
- **More audio formats.** AAC, FLAC, and Apple Lossless decode, including inside MP4/M4A files and DASH fragments.

## Native UI

- New `SplitButton`: a button joined to a menu of related actions.
- New `ListState.Choose`, so the app can choose a row.
- Charts support logarithmic and symmetric log scales.
- Scroll bars are styled like VS Code's editor, and each axis can hide its indicators.
- Focus scrolls the element into view, and `FocusOptions.PreventScroll` keeps the scroll where it is.
- Accessibility: status messages are read out, tab panels and landmarks are announced, menu buttons say they open a menu, and read-only state is reported on more controls.
- Lists, outlines, and context menus do less work per frame.

## Editor, rich text, and Markdown

- The code editor highlights Svelte, HCL/Terraform, ERB, Jinja, and Nix. Scripts are recognized by their `#!` line.
- Unified diffs and patches show their files, and read-only diffs end correctly at the final newline.
- Inline widgets can sit at the end of a line without capturing the caret.
- The rich text editor can hide its scroll bar, leave room above paragraphs, and report where the caret is. Apps can take keys, draw spans, and add to its menu.
- Markdown can turn inline code into links with `Options.CodeLink`.

## App and platform

- `App.Relaunch` accepts arguments for the new instance.
- `App.ClearWindowStates` resets saved window positions.
- `App.ChosenLocale` reports the language the app chose, or "" when it follows the system.
- Quit handlers run when the OS ends the session (logout or shutdown), so apps can save state then.
- `Power.KeepRunning` stops macOS from throttling a background app, without keeping the computer awake.
- `Window.SetInputRegion` lets a window take clicks only on parts of it, for things like desktop pets.
- `ClipboardOptions.Concealed` marks passwords and other secrets so clipboard managers leave them out of their histories.
- `Shell.DefaultApp` reports the app that opens a URL. `Shell.PreviewItem` shows a file in Quick Look on macOS.
- Terminals let apps take dropped files first with `Options.OnDrop`.
- Apps can choose which client certificate a server asks for.
- The updater offers a release published while its window is open, retries when a server fails briefly, and shows release notes in more cases. `OnInstalled` runs once an update is installed.
- URLs that contain credentials are rejected by the fetch plugin.

## Tooling

- `mygo dev` signs the macOS development app with your Apple Development identity. Permissions and Keychain access survive rebuilds.
- `mygo dev -background` keeps the app from taking focus.
- Linux packages can be built as RPMs, and `linux.depends` accepts per-format dependencies.

## Fixes

- **macOS:** minimized windows count as visible, native popovers follow the app's appearance, hidden or minimized windows draw at once, and password fields stay unreadable to assistive technology.
- **Windows:** transparent WebView backgrounds render correctly. Chinese text uses one font on English Windows. Numbers and Latin text wrap correctly. Native opening transitions are kept.
- **Linux:** template tray icons are white on dark desktops. Glyph positions match GTK. Default-app lookup works for files without an extension.
